title: The beauty backfire effect: Being too attractive can hurt fitness influencers, new research shows
titleZh: 颜值反噬：身材完美的健身网红为什么不吸粉
summary:
长期以来，“性感营销”（sex sells）一直被广告界奉为金科玉律。作为消费者行为研究者，我们发现，大量研究都印证了这一点：使用外形出众的模特或代言人能够稳定吸引注意力、提升点击率，并使产品显得更具吸引力。但我们最新的研究表明，在当今这个网红遍地的数字时代——他们拥有庞大的粉丝群体，常被视作值得信赖的潮流引领者——外形太有吸引力反而可能适得其反，特别是在健身领域。我们将这一现象称为“美貌反噬效应”（beauty backfire effect），并且已经通过一系列实验室研究对其进行了验证。

来源：对话杂志；作者：Andrew Edelblum&Abby Frank；原文发布时间：2025-11-06 20:00:00

paragraphs.contentEn: “Sex sells” has been a mantra in marketing for decades. As researchers who study consumer behavior, we’ve seen plenty of evidence to support it: Attractive models and spokespeople have been shown to reliably grab attention, boost clicks and make products seem more desirable. But our new research suggests that in a digital world full of influencers – trusted tastemakers with large online followings – being too attractive can actually backfire, particularly in the fitness space. We call this the “beauty backfire effect,” and we put it to the test in a series of laboratory experiments.
paragraphs.contentZh: 长期以来，“性感营销”（sex sells）一直被广告界奉为金科玉律。作为消费者行为研究者，我们发现，大量研究都印证了这一点：使用外形出众的模特或代言人能够稳定吸引注意力、提升点击率，并使产品显得更具吸引力。但我们最新的研究表明，在当今这个网红遍地的数字时代——他们拥有庞大的粉丝群体，常被视作值得信赖的潮流引领者——外形太有吸引力反而可能适得其反，特别是在健身领域。我们将这一现象称为“美貌反噬效应”（beauty backfire effect），并且已经通过一系列实验室研究对其进行了验证。

paragraphs.contentEn: We showed hundreds of study participants mock Instagram posts from fictitious fitness influencer accounts. The posts were identical in every way, except for one key difference: how attractive the influencer was. We judged this by asking independent raters to evaluate photos of real influencers ahead of time. The results were striking: We found that extremely attractive fitness influencers – or “fitfluencers” – got fewer likes and follows than their moderately attractive peers.
paragraphs.contentZh: 我们招募了数百名受试者，向他们展示了一组虚构的健身网红账号及其发布的Instagram帖子。所有帖子在内容上都完全一致，唯一的关键区别在于网红的外形吸引力。为了科学划分吸引力水平，我们事先邀请独立评估员对真实网红的照片进行打分评级。研究结果令人意外：那些外形出众的健身网红（即“fitfluencers”）所获得的点赞和关注数量，反而少于外形吸引力中等的健身网红。

paragraphs.contentEn: Why? Because people viewed them as less relatable. In fact, in one of our studies, people who saw an extremely attractive fitfluencer reported having lower self-esteem afterward. In contrast, seeing a moderately attractive fitfluencer gave some participants a small confidence boost, likely because the image felt more attainable. Interestingly, the beauty backfire effect wasn’t as strong in other domains. When we ran the same experiment with finance influencers in the mix, appearance didn’t matter as much. That’s not entirely surprising, of course. For a financial coach, looks aren’t tied to credibility. Meanwhile, for a fitness coach, they’re central.
paragraphs.contentZh: 为什么会出现这种情况？原因在于，人们难以与这些外形完美的网红产生共鸣。事实上，在我们其中一项研究中，参与者在看到外形极为优越的健身网红后，自尊水平有所下降。相反，在看外表中等的健身网红时，部分参与者的自信心反而略有提升，这可能是因为这样的形象更容易让人感到自己也能做到。有意思的是，这种“美貌反噬效应”在其他领域并不显著。当我们用同样的实验方法测试财经类网红时，外表吸引力的影响几乎可以忽略不计。这一点其实不难理解。对理财教练而言，外貌与其专业可信度关联不大。但对健身教练来说，外形本身就是他们的核心竞争力。

paragraphs.contentEn: But the beauty backfire effect isn’t inevitable. In a final analysis, we explored whether self-presentation style could close the relatability gap. When highly attractive influencers adopted a humble tone, sharing their struggles, training challenges or fitness plateaus, the engagement gap disappeared, we found. But when they adopted a prideful tone, boasting about their natural talent or exceptional dedication, the gap grew even larger. This suggests that humility can be a powerful communication tool for influencers who might otherwise seem “out of reach.”
paragraphs.contentZh: 不过，“美貌反噬效应”并非无法避免。在最后的分析中，我们探讨了不同的自我呈现方式是否能缩小这种距离感。我们发现，当外形出众的健身网红以谦逊的语气，主动分享自己遇到的困境、训练中的挑战或健身瓶颈时，之前观察到的粉丝互动差距便会随之消失。相反，如果他们以自夸的语气，强调自己的天赋或极致的自律，这种差距会进一步扩大。这一发现表明，对于那些容易让粉丝感到“高不可攀”的健身网红而言，保持谦逊可能是一种非常有效的沟通策略。

paragraphs.contentEn: Fitfluencers depend on their appearance as a kind of credential. A sculpted physique signals expertise in health and wellness. But engagement isn’t just about how good someone looks on camera. It’s about whether followers feel they can connect with them. This is where relatability comes in. Audiences connect with fitfluencers who feel like real, reachable versions of themselves. But extreme attractiveness does the opposite: It turns an attainable goal into an impossible ideal, and what should inspire instead alienates.
paragraphs.contentZh: 健身网红常以优越的外形作为一种专业资质。匀称健美的身材，象征着他们在健康与健身领域的专业能力。然而，粉丝是否愿意与之互动，并不只取决于他们在镜头前有多好看。关键在于关注者是否感到能与对方建立联系。这正是“可共鸣性”成为关键因素的所在。观众之所以愿意互动，是因为这些健身网红看起来真实、像是努力一点就能成为的自己。如果外形过于完美，效果可能适得其反：它将一个本可实现的目标变成了遥不可及的理想，使原本应当激励人心的形象反而令人感到疏离。

paragraphs.contentEn: This effect aligns with classic social comparison theory. People judge themselves in relation to others. If the gap between self and fitfluencer seems too wide, comparisons become discouraging, not motivating. In other words, the more “perfect” the fitfluencer looks, the less followers believe they can realistically be like them – and the less likely they are to engage. Social media platforms have been taking note. These days, TikTok, Snapchat and other outlets build their appeal on candid, authentic content over polished, airbrushed imagery. In this new landscape, perfection can be a liability.
paragraphs.contentZh: 这种“美貌反噬效应”与经典的社会比较理论高度契合。该理论指出，人们往往通过与他人比较来评价自己。当自我与健身网红之间的差距过大时，比较所带来的可能不再是激励，而是挫败感。换句话说，健身网红的形象越趋于完美，粉丝就越难以相信自己也能达到类似的状态——互动的意愿也随之下降。社交媒体平台显然也意识到了这一点。如今，像TikTok、Snapchat这类平台的内容策略，越来越倾向于真实、自然的表达，而非精修、滤镜下的完美形象。在这样的新内容生态中，完美反而可能成为一种负担。

paragraphs.contentEn: Our research shows that extreme attractiveness might grab attention but can undermine connection, the true currency of the influencer economy. For brands and creators, the takeaway is clear: Success may depend less on looking flawless and more on sounding real. Our findings raise new questions about how beauty shapes influence online. For instance, gender appears to matter. In a follow-up study, highly attractive female fitness influencers faced stronger backlash than equally attractive men, perhaps reflecting a broader social tendency to judge women’s looks more harshly. Future research could explore whether similar biases apply to other visible traits, such as race or disability.
paragraphs.contentZh: 我们的研究表明，虽然出众的外表确实能吸引注意力，但也可能削弱网红经济中真正的硬通货：连接感。对品牌和内容创作者而言，结论十分明确：成功或许不取决于外表的完美无瑕，而在于表达是否真实可信。我们的发现也引出了新的问题：出众的外表究竟如何在线上塑造影响力？例如，性别似乎是一个重要变量。在后续的一项研究中，我们发现，外表出众的女性健身网红，比条件相当的男性更容易遭遇“美貌反噬”，这或许反映了社会在外表评判中对女性更为苛刻的倾向。未来的研究可以进一步探讨，类似的偏见是否也存在于种族、身体残障等其他显性特征上。

paragraphs.contentEn: The effect may also extend beyond fitness. Industries built around appearance – fashion, beauty or lifestyle content – could show the same pattern. Finally, not all audiences respond alike. People new to fitness or younger users still forming their identities may be especially prone to negative comparisons with highly attractive fitfluencers. Understanding these differences could help creators and platforms foster healthier engagement online.
paragraphs.contentZh: “美貌反噬效应”或许不止存在于健身领域。那些高度依赖外形资本的行业——如时尚、美妆或生活方式内容——或许同样遵循这一规律。最后，不同受众的反应也存在差异。刚开始接触健身的人，或那些仍在建立自我认同的年轻用户，尤其容易在面对外表出众的健身网红时陷入负面的自我比较。理解这些差异，将有助于内容创作者和平台共同构建更健康的线上互动环境。
